name: sap.mcp/metrics_api
title: metrics_api
description: MCP server for the metrics_api service.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_app_process_metrics
tools.title: GET_subaccount_app_process_metrics
tools.description: Returns the metrics of the requested processes in the requested application and subaccount. To receive any process metrics, the process and its Java application have to be running.

processid.description: Unique ID of a single application process

tools.name: GET_subaccount_app_metrics
tools.title: GET_subaccount_app_metrics
tools.description: Returns the metrics of the requested application in the requested subaccount. To receive any application metrics, the Java application has to be running.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_app_process_state
tools.title: GET_subaccount_app_process_state
tools.description: Returns the state of the requested processes in the requested application and subaccount. To receive the process state, the process and its Java application have to be running.

processid.description: Unique ID of a single application process

tools.name: GET_subaccount_app_state
tools.title: GET_subaccount_app_state
tools.description: Returns the state of the requested application in the requested subaccount. To receive the application state, the Java application has to be running.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_dbsystem_metrics
tools.title: GET_subaccount_dbsystem_metrics
tools.description: Returns the metrics for the requested database in the requested subaccount. To receive any database metrics, your database system has to be up and running.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_dbsystem_state
tools.title: GET_subaccount_dbsystem_state
tools.description: Returns the state of the requested database in the requested subaccount. To receive the database state, your database system has to be up and running.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_instance_app_metrics
tools.title: GET_subaccount_instance_app_metrics
tools.description: Returns the custom HTTP checks for the requested XS application in the requested XS instance and subaccount.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_instance_metrics
tools.title: GET_subaccount_instance_metrics
tools.description: Returns the metrics for all applications in the requested subaccount and XS instance.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_instance_app_state
tools.title: GET_subaccount_instance_app_state
tools.description: Returns the states of the requested XS instance and its applications in the requested subaccount.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_instance_state
tools.title: GET_subaccount_instance_state
tools.description: Returns the state of the applications in the requested subaccount and XS instance.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_html_app_metrics
tools.title: GET_subaccount_html_app_metrics
tools.description: Returns the metrics of the requested HTML5 application in the requested subaccount.

tools.name: GET_subaccount_html_app_state
tools.title: GET_subaccount_html_app_state
tools.description: Returns the state of the requested HTML5 application in the requested subaccount.
